summary: Feed s180_triple to 10 Gbps NDR is degraded: microbursts to 16.73 Gbps (167% of port capacity) are overloading the tool and causing 3.3% TCP packet loss, plus 94.3% encrypted traffic exceeds the NDR's 90% tolerance limiting payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: NDR 10 Gbps ingress port is oversubscribed by microbursts peaking at 16.73 Gbps (167% of capacity) in 2 intervals. Packet broker is delivering aggregate traffic without load-balancing across multiple tool ports, causing buffer exhaustion and tail drops.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR drops packets under burst, loses flows and state, misses detections and generates incomplete session records; effective coverage drops sharply during peaks.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2+ NDR ports/instances with 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port peak <80% (8 Gbps) and eliminate burst drops. Fixes overload and will also resolve correlated packet loss.

findings.root_cause: 273 of 8227 TCP packets (3.3%, threshold 1%) show gaps/retransmissions indicating missing data in the broker-to-tool path. Correlated with tool overload bursts, indicating drops at the overloaded 10G tool port/broker egress buffers, not normal network loss.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reassemble TCP streams with full payload (needs_full_payload=true), causing failed application decoding, missed IDS signatures, and blind spots for lateral movement/exfiltration.

recommended_fix.why: Packet loss is symptomatic of the same overload; load-balancing to multiple 10G tool ports and verifying broker egress queue drops will bring loss below 1% and restore complete TCP reassembly.

findings.root_cause: 94.27% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) vs NDR tolerance of 90%. NDR requires full payload inspection but traffic is opaque without decryption, common when broker forwards internet/TLS-heavy segments directly.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to 94% of payloads, can only do metadata/flow analysis; cannot detect payload-based threats, malware C2, or data exfiltration inside TLS.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption (or forward relevant TLS to a decryption zone) before the NDR, or tune NDR to focus on metadata for encrypted flows while decrypting high-risk categories to restore payload visibility without exceeding 90% encrypted threshold.
